mission: Build an open, local-first, benchmark-driven engine that turns natural-language ideas and real-world subjects into playable simulations and production-quality web/game experiences.

aaa_reference.use: Benchmark observable production qualities such as world density, environmental consistency, animation, streaming, NPC behavior, vehicle/physics feel, UI, audio, performance, and immersion. Do not copy Rockstar assets, code, characters, maps, story, or proprietary implementation.
aaa_reference.release_reference: Rockstar currently lists Grand Theft Auto VI for November 19, 2026.

aec_bridge: BIM and game-engine research supports using structured building models and metadata as interactive worlds, enabling walkthroughs, navigation, accessibility, circulation, egress, building operation, and education simulations.
learning_game_rule: Any supported subject should be convertible into a custom simulation with objectives, actions, consequences, feedback, scoring, difficulty progression, and benchmark evidence.
cost_policy: Use free/local/open tooling first. Paid model or service use requires explicit user approval.
dependency_reduction: Every successful external-model-assisted build becomes an opportunity for Buddy to implement a local/original capability and add a regression benchmark.
safety: Use licensed/authorized assets and APIs; do not copy proprietary game content or bypass access controls.
